obernants.approximation_semantics: Scoped relation, not a universal numerical certificate
obernants.assumptions: Successful allocations and each leaf's finite domain/error precedence. These are tagged relations, not automatic production adoption. Floating residuals are not solution-error guarantees. No generic 1/2/5/10% composition-wide profile; finite evidence remains separate from analytical claims.
obernants.domain: Leaf-admitted bounded weights, state sequences, nonnegative matrices, target marginals, finite vectors and externally supplied sampling variates; support and zero behavior as declared.
obernants.observation_scope: Tagged API values, states, errors and separately recorded finite joins
obernants.operator: Exclude V>Z for identical nonnegative path weights beyond documented rounding tolerance; posterior normalization at Z=0 contrary to status/error rules; invalid alias variates; exhausted Sinkhorn residuals treated as exact marginals; covariance with a substituted denominator.
